entries.d835bd9f944c7f9f: The company's single segment manufactures and sells amino acid-related, chemical product-related and pharmaceutical-related products. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥15,448 million. Its main production site is the Tokiwa Plant in Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, and headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 296. Yuki Techno Service Co., Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary, mainly undertakes manufacturing contracts for the company and other work.
entries.dec69b416da2b3fa: The company manufactures and sells raw materials such as amino acids and vitamins. They are used for pharmaceutical and food additive purposes. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,156 million. In June 2025, new equipment to increase glycine production was installed at the Tokiwa Plant.
